content: Cisimo ca Vaka Kupanga mu Citungu ca Mikolovozi ya Vushuka vua Viniu

Kaha uaputukile kuhandeka kuli vakevo mu visimo nguendio, “Yala uakunine citungu ca mikolovozi, kaha uazinguisileko cipatanga, kaha uahindile cina ca kukamuinamo viniu, kaha naua uatungile kaposhi, nakusezela vaka kupanga, kaha uaile ku lifuti lieka.
Kaha omo ntsimbu yakuteja yahetele, uatumine ngamba kuli vaka kupanga, linga vambate vushuka mu citungu ca mikolovozi.
Kaha vamukuatele na kumupupa, na kumusheka mavoko voko.
Kaha naua uatumine mukuavo ngamba, kaha vamuvetuesele ku mutue, nakumulinga muashuamua.
Kaha uatumine mukuavo, kaha naua vamutsihile, navakuavo naua vavalingile muje vene, vamo vavapupangele vamo vava tsihile.
Kaha kuasalele umo, muana ua yala yazangele, ha mamanusuilo uamutumine kuli vakevo, nakuvalekesa nguendi, ‘Vakasingimika munange.’
Vuno honi vaje vaka kupanga vahandekele kuli umo na mukuavo nguavo, ‘Ou ikeye muna vavenia citungu, ijeni, tumutsihe, kaha vufuko vupua vuetu.’
Kaha vamukuatele nakumutsiha, nakumumbila kusinia lia citungu.”
Kaha Yesu uavehuile nguendi, “Vika honi, viakalinga vavenia citungu ca mikolovozi?” Kaha vamukumbuluile nguavo, “Akeja nakutsiha vaka kupanga, nakuhana citungu ca mikolovozi ku veka.”
Ku muatandele evi visoneka?

content.text: likelio linapu lia seho kuli voshe,

content: Kaha vesekele linga vamukute, vuno honi vateuele civunga ca vantu, omuo vasinganiekele nguavo nahandeka cisimo eci kuluisa vakevo, kaha vamusezele na kuya.
Cihula ca ha Kufueta Lisimu
Kaha vatumine vamo Vafaliseo na vaka mpunga ya Helonde, kuli Yesu linga vamukuate kuya nomu muahandekela.

Kaha vezile nakuhandeka kuli ikeye nguavo, “Mulongisi, tuatantekeya nguetu uapua ua vusunga, omuo kuesi kutala hali muntu cipue uapua ua vulemu cipue kuahi kuuesi kulipesa ha muntu ha viyongola via muntu, kuuesi kutala hacituamo ca muntu, kaha naua ukalongesa via vusunga via Njambi. Capandemo kufueta lisimu kuli Sezale, indi kuahi?”
Tuvafuete indi, keti tuvafuete? Vuno honi Yesu hakumona visinganieka via vipi, uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vika munjesekela? Njineheleni mbongo ya muuaya uaya, njiyitale.”
Vanehele ije mbongo ya muuaya uaya. Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Cihanga ceya eci ciliho na lizina lieya liliho?” Vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Via Sezale.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Haneni Kasezale viakundama kuli Kasezale, na kuli Njambi viakundama kuli Njambi.” Kaha voshe vakomokele hali ikeye.
Cihula ca ha Vulo ca Kusanguka ku Vatsi
Kaha Vasanduki vezile kuli ikeye, vaje vakahandeka nguavo kukuesi kusanguka ku vatsi, kaha vamuhuile cihula nguavo,

“Mulongisi, Mosesa uatusonekelele nguendi, ‘Nga muanaye atsa kaha naseze mpuevo, vuno honi kasezele muana, uje yala napande kuambata uje mpuevo, linga asemeneko vana vaje vanapandele kusemenako ikeye.’
Mulizimo liavo vapuile vatanu na vavali, uakulivanga uambatele mpuevo, kaha omo uatsile kasezele vana,
Kaha ua mucivali ua muambatele, kaha nendi naua uatsile, kasezele vana, na ua mucitatu naikeye naua cifua cimo,
kaha voshe kuvasezele vana. Kumamanuisilo uje mpue vo uatsile.
Hakusanguka uje mpuevo a kapua ueya? Vaje vatanu na vavali voshe uapuile mpuevo yavo.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nkuma ku muatantekeye ngueni muapihisa, omuo kumutantekeya visoneka cipue nzili ya Njambi?
Omo vakahinduka ku vatsi, ku vakambata cipue kushuombuesa, vuno honi vakapua ngue tungelo va muilu.
Kaha ha kusanguka vatsi, kumuatandele mu livulu lia Mosesa, hali lije liputa, omo Njambi uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, ‘Yange Njambi ua Avilahama, na Njambi ua Isake, na Njambi ua Yakomba’?
Keti Njambi uavakakutsa, vuno honi Njambi ua vakakuyoya, unapihisa.”
Lishiko Liakama Cikuma

Kaha umo ua valongisi va mashiko uahetele kaha ua vovuile valinga vimpata kuli umo na mukuavo, kaha hakumona ngeci Yesu uavakumbuluile muacili, kaha vamuihuile nguavo, “Lishiko muka ku mashiko oshe lia kulivanga?”
Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Cakulivanga eci, ‘Tolilila, Yove Isaleli! Muene Njambi yetu, uapua Muene umo,
kaha mu kazanga Muene yeni na mitima yeni yoshe, na muono ueni uoshe, na mana eni oshe, na nzili yeni yoshe.’
Lishiko lia mu civali eli, ‘Zanga mukueni ngue muje muualizanga yove vavenia.’ Kukuesi naua lishiko liakama cikuma lipulakana aua.”
Kaha mulongisi ua mashiko vehuile Yesu nguendi, “Uahandeka vusunga, Mulongisi, vusunga vene uapua umo lika, kaha kukuesi ueka kuvanga ikeye lika,
kaha ku muzanga na mutima uoshe, nakuvuisisa kuoshe, na nzili yoshe, nakuzanga mukueni ngue omuo ualizangela yove vavenia, viapulakana na tusitu va cikombelo na vikombelo vikuavo naua.”
Kaha omo Yesu uamuene nguendi uakumbuluile na mana, uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Kuuesi kulahako na vumuene vua Njambi.” Kuhuma haje naumo uahi naua uamuihuile cihula.
Uakuvuavesa uapua Muna Iya?
Kaha omo Yesu uakele nakulongesa mu njivo ya Njambi, uahandekele nguendi, “Cijavati honi linga vaka kulongesa mashiko vahandeke nguavo Kilistu muna Ndaviti?
Ndaviti vavenia, vamuvuavesele na Cimbembesi Uakulela kaha uahandekele nguendi,

content.text: tumama ku livoko liange lia cilio,
kuvanga noho njikahaka vitozi veni ku viliato vieni.’

content: Ndaviti vavenia amusana nguendi ‘Muene,’ kaha cifua vati honi linga apue munendi?” Yesu Anangula linga Vazangame kuli Valongisi va Mezi a Mashiko (Mateu23:1-36; Luka20:45-47) Civunga covuilille kuli ikeye nakuvuahelela.
Kaha omo Yesu uakele nakulongesa uahandekele nguendi, “Zangameni kuli valongisi va mashiko, vaje vakai nakuenda mu tuzaku tualaha linga vavasingimike mu mihela ya kulandesela,
na vituamo viacili via mu vi njivo ya malombelo na mihela ya kasingimiko ya ku viuano,
vaje vali na kupihisa vinjivo via vantuluue mukulimuesa ha kulombela malombelo alaha. Vakatambula cihiso cakama.”
Mulambu ua Ntuluue
Kaha Yesu uatumamene kuyehi nakuakutambuila milambu, kaha uakele nakutala vantu omo vakele na kuhaka vimbongo mu cikuama ca njivo ya Njambi. Vavengi vakakufuka vakele nakulambuila vimbongo viavingi.
Kaha ntuluue uakuhutua uezile, kaha ualambuile tuuaya uaya tuvali tua vunengu tuatundende.

Kaha uasanene valongisi vendi linga veje kuli ikeye, kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Cilivene njimileka nguange, ou ntuluue uacihutu nalambula viavingi kupulakana voshe vaje vanalambula mu cikuama.
Omuo voshe vanalambuile kusetekesa na vufuko vuavo vuavuingi, vuno honi ikeye nalambuila kuya mukuhutua cendi kaha naua ualambuila vioshe vimbongo viakele navio, viaku muyoyesa mu vuyoye vuendi.”
